name: Turtle trading (System 1)

source.label: The Turtle rules taught by Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt in 1983 (System 1), as published in Curtis Faith's "The Original Turtle Trading Rules"

rules: Buy when the daily close breaks above the highest high of the previous 20 days.
Sell when the daily close breaks below the lowest low of the previous 10 days.
Hold one position per coin at a time, sized at the coin's whole budget.
notExpressed: Position size from volatility (the N unit, a 20-day average true range)
Adding up to three more units every half N the trade moves in your favour
Skipping a breakout after a winning breakout
Short trades (the test is spot, long only)
